Shurikenjutsu is the term for traditional Japanese martial arts that involve small, sharp weapons. While it used to be a specialty of the samurai, the practice has become more egalitarian in recent history. That said, today's street samurai could only dream of wielding a weapon to match Saburo Arasaka's kaiken.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: Go ahead, try to steal it from Saburo (Cannot be Fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged).

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: Melee

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: When this weapon is thrown and the user rolls for damage, 4s and 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries. If this weapon’s target suffered a Critical Injury from this weapon or Satori on the previous Round, then when this weapon now incurs a Critical Injury, it deals 5 additional Bonus Damage (10 Total) and restores 5 HP to its user. Unlike a typical melee weapon not designed for throwing, this weapon continues to halve SP when thrown.

Fabrication: Go ahead, try to steal it from Saburo (Cannot be Fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged).
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
